mapper.select: SELECT slide.image_id AS image_id, slide.can_serve_tiles AS can_serve_tiles, slide.source_url AS source_url, slide.tile_metadata_json AS tile_metadata_json, slide.thumbnail_url AS thumbnail_url, slide.thumbnail_width AS thumbnail_width, slide.thumbnail_height AS thumbnail_height, slide.thumbnail_content_type AS thumbnail_content_type FROM cancer_study study INNER JOIN ( SELECT cancer_study_id, argMax(release_id, (released_at, release_id)) AS release_id FROM wsi_release GROUP BY cancer_study_id ) active_release ON active_release.cancer_study_id = study.cancer_study_id INNER JOIN wsi_slide slide ON slide.cancer_study_id = active_release.cancer_study_id AND slide.release_id = active_release.release_id AND slide.image_id = #{imageId} WHERE study.cancer_study_identifier = #{studyId} LIMIT 1
